description: JVM and HTTP metrics for the Micrometer-instrumented services on this box (planelyx-api via Spring Boot Actuator, planelyx-auth via Quarkus). Keyed on the job and instance labels Prometheus attaches from prometheus/targets/<env>/*.yml — deliberately not on an `application` label, which nothing here emits.

panels.title: planelyx targets
panels.description: Is Prometheus actually scraping each app? If this says DOWN, the panels below are empty because of the app or the network, not the dashboard.

panels.title: Restarts (range)
panels.description: Process restarts over the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(jvm_memory_used_bytes{job="$job", instance="$instance", area="heap"}) / sum(jvm_memory_max_bytes{job="$job", instance="$instance", area="heap"})

panels.title: Request rate by status
panels.description: Spring Boot only. Keycloak reports its own http_server_requests series but with Quarkus label values, so this row stays sparse for planelyx-auth.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Percentiles come from the native histogram buckets, which exist because planelyx-api sets management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram.

panels.title: Time spent in GC
panels.description: Seconds of pause per second of wall clock — effectively the fraction of time the JVM spent stopped for GC.

panels.title: Long-lived heap after GC
panels.description: A live-data line that climbs and never falls back is the shape of a leak.

panels.title: Hikari connections
panels.description: planelyx-api only — Keycloak does not use HikariCP, so this row is empty for planelyx-auth.

title: JVM — Micrometer
